<DOCSTRING>
Checks if a person is an adult based on their age.

Determines if a person is 18 or older, which is the legal age for adulthood in many jurisdictions. This function is useful for validating user age in applications that require age-based access controls.

@constructor
@param {string} name - The name of the person.
@param {number} age - The age of the person.
</DOCSTRING>
